bases.address: Site / civic address not publicly specified
bases.notes: FRS-003-13, budget pp.39-40 (PDF pages61-62), confirms property acquired August 2024 and a future purpose-built replacement. Existing 815 Goyeau station remains in the operational directory.
bases.expectedOpening: Estimated project completion 2032 in approved 2026 capital budget; operational opening not confirmed

bases.name: Annexed lands — conditional future fire station / multi-purpose complex
bases.shortName: Annexed lands — conditional future fire station / multi-purpose complex
bases.address: Annexed southeast lands, Windsor — no selected street site located
bases.notes: Council report C112/2024 distinguishes a downtown station/HQ replacement from a possible combined training/apparatus/new-station complex in annexed lands if growth warrants it. This is a conditional long-term concept, with no station number, selected parcel, construction contract or opening confirmed. The 2026 training/apparatus budget instead describes an addition at the current building; do not treat that addition as proof this new station is proceeding.

bases.name: New central EMS hub and headquarters
bases.shortName: New central EMS hub and headquarters
bases.address: Windsor — acquired property street address not located in checked public sources
bases.notes: The official August 2025 update explicitly locates the proposed central hub in Windsor. June 2026 update confirms land acquisition for this HQ and two Windsor satellites, with financial development planning through the 2027 budget process. The budget describes consolidating crews and ambulances; no individual existing-base retirement is assumed. No physical construction or opening confirmed.
